tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background and full-bleed sections. Every screen starts here; in dark the ground is true black.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised panels, table headers and nav drawers sitting on `surface-100`.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Inset wells, input fills and chart plot areas on `surface-100` or `surface-200`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, solid-button fill and key icons on `surface-100`, `surface-200` and `surface-300`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions and table cells on `surface-100`, `surface-200` and `surface-300`.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, axis labels, captions and placeholder text on `surface-100`, `surface-200` and `surface-300`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel outlines. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, tabs and quiet buttons. Holds 3:1 against `surface-100` through `surface-300` in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single brand accent (ion blue): focus ring, selected state, primary data series, links. As text it reads on `surface-100`, `surface-200` and `surface-300`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text or icons placed on a solid `accent` fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus outline with 2px offset, on every surface.

tokens.name: status-nominal
tokens.usage: Healthy or in-tolerance state. Always paired with the word NOMINAL or a check icon. Blue, so it never relies on green versus red.

tokens.name: status-caution
tokens.usage: Degrading or near-limit state, with the word CAUTION. Reads as text on `surface-100` to `surface-300`.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: Failure or out-of-bounds state, with the word CRITICAL. Reads as text on `surface-100` to `surface-300`.

tokens.name: thermal-1
tokens.usage: Coolest end of the thermal scale in heat maps and placement maps (low stress).

tokens.name: thermal-2
tokens.usage: Cool-mid step of the thermal scale.

tokens.name: thermal-3
tokens.usage: Neutral midpoint of the diverging thermal scale.

tokens.name: thermal-4
tokens.usage: Warm-mid step of the thermal scale.

tokens.name: thermal-5
tokens.usage: Hottest end of the thermal scale (high stress, shortest life).

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
